lines.text: Ladies and gentlemen — your Miami Mighty Geckz!
Geckz score! Kai Sandoval lights the lamp at Neon Reef Stadium!
Final from Neon Reef — Miami Mighty Geckz win!
Now entering the ice — your McLean Cardinals!
Cardinals score! Nathaniel Cross buries it at Cardinal Perch Gardens!
Final from the Perch — McLean Cardinals win!
Capital city, make some noise — your Washington Whoomp!
Whoomp score! Marcus Doyle finishes at the District Dome!
Final from the Dome — Washington Whoomp win!
All aboard — your Chattanooga Choo Choo!
Choo Choo score! Wyatt Combs puts one home at Terminal Arena!
Final from the Terminal — Chattanooga Choo Choo win!
